body:
## Proposal

Add an optional, installable `ws-senior-developer` skill that provides a concise, portable engineering-delivery gate for consumer repositories.

The shared hub already resolves an optional `rules.seniorDeveloper` dependency and refers to it for code-review proof. This proposal would supply a maintained upstream implementation instead of requiring each consumer to create a local equivalent.

## Intended behavior

Before non-trivial implementation, the skill should guide agents to:

- Think before coding: inspect project context, constraints, and relevant anti-regression memory.
- Use a plan-first default for multi-file or multi-modification free-text requests; confirm the plan before changing code.
- Prefer the project workflow and specifications: add, update, or sync specs when appropriate; use the installed orchestration skills rather than immediately vibe-coding.
- Follow consumer project rules and architecture constraints.
- Apply delivery gates before shipping a branch or PR: focused quality review, tests/build/format or project-configured verification, secrets checks where configured, and relevant documentation/index updates.
- Report evidence and unresolved blockers instead of claiming completion prematurely.

## Scope and integration questions

- Package it as `ws-senior-developer`, likely model-invoked only when an agent needs the durable guardrails.
- Keep consumer-root `AGENTS.md` as the portable single source of truth for local policy. The skill should reinforce and operationalize that policy, not duplicate/rewrite it.
- Make consumer autoload **optional**, selected through the installer/configuration or a documented root-AGENTS pointer. Always-on installation should be evaluated against context load and existing Layer 0 skills (`ws-caveman`, `ws-gabarito`, `ws-karpathy-guidelines`).
- Define how it participates in `rules.seniorDeveloper`, including the canonical code-review proof checklist and opt-out semantics.
- Avoid making trivial/single-file changes unnecessarily ceremonial; explicit implementation or named workflow commands should still be honored.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Installable `ws-senior-developer` skill with clear invocation mode and concise scope.
- [ ] Checkable pre-implementation and pre-ship criteria, including plan/spec/workflow and verification gates.
- [ ] Clear integration with `rules.seniorDeveloper` and code-review proof consumers.
- [ ] Documented optional consumer-AGENTS autoload/pointer strategy.
- [ ] No duplication of consumer-specific policies or managed-skill edits in consumer repos.
- [ ] Evals cover multi-file free-text work, trivial fixes, explicit implementation commands, and a ship/PR handoff.
title: Add optional ws-senior-developer engineering delivery gate
